title: •Quietly Observing
caption: •Quietly Observing (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Once per game, may ▼ Bluffs. Bluffs gains {light-force} and {dark-force}. Once per battle, may deploy a bluff card (if it is a character or vehicle) as a ‘react.’ To reveal a bluff card, opponent must first use X Force, where X = 4 - number of bluff cards. {alter}
lore: On her assignment to kill Sharad Hett, Aurra used her patience and cunning to help track down the Jedi Master.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Inline icons: blue saber box then red saber box → {light-force} and {dark-force} (stub has them in the opposite order: '[Dark Side] and [Light Side]'). Curly ‘react.’ (stub straight). '4 - number' printed with a short hyphen, kept. Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Lore matches the 350 px scan (no corrections). Copyright 2001 read off the scan. Modern: V11-D-quietlyobserving.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 11 remake with different text and no lore box — art only); VB4 -pre (350) also exists.
